description: This file implements the main page component for a Trip Dashboard in a Next.js project. It manages fetching and displaying user trip data, handles trip creation and deletion, and includes UI components for loading, error, and empty states. It also contains a modal for creating new trips.

methods.name: fetchTrips
methods.description: Fetches trips data from backend or populates demo data if backend is unavailable.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a trip by ID, with confirmation dialog and fallback for demo mode.

methods.name: CreateTripModal
methods.description: Component for creating a new trip via modal form.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating a new trip, triggering API call and resetting form.
